issues.legal_issue: A lease deed granting a fixed initial term and providing for rent enhancement in connection with renewals does not permit enhancement during the initial term when the renewal provisions operate only at its end.
material_facts: The deed granted a fixed initial lease term at a stated annual rent, in consideration of a premium.
The renewal covenant provided for new leases at the end of the term granted and at the end of successive renewal terms.
A separate covenant made rent subject to enhancement on a renewal.
The lessor’s successor increased the rent and demanded arrears during the initial term.
The lessee sought a declaration that the rent could not be enhanced during that term.
issues.conclusion: The enhancement clause could operate only upon the grant of a fresh lease after expiry of the initial term, so rent could not be enhanced during the initial lease. The appeal was dismissed.
issues.legal_principle: A deed must be construed from its language read as a whole, ordinarily applying the literal rule unless it produces an absurd result. The construction should give effect to all clauses rather than render any nugatory. Sections 90–94 of the Indian Evidence Act give statutory recognition to the primary rule of construction, subject to the exceptions in Sections 95–98. Where uncertainty in a grant cannot be resolved, ambiguous words may be disregarded so that clear operative terms prevail; where two reasonable constructions remain, the construction favouring the grantee over the grantor is preferred. The Court relied on Monypenny v. Monypenny, Re Meredith, ex parte Chick, Radha Sunder Dutta v. Mohd. Jahadur Rahim, Sahebzada Mohd. Kamgar Shah v. Jagdish Chandra Rao Dhabel Deo, Smt. Bina Das Gupta v. Sachindra Mohan Das Gupta, Glynn v. Margetson & Co., and Raja Rajendra Chand v. Mst. Sukhi. It did not apply a special rule construing grants in favour of the sovereign, particularly where the grant was for valuable consideration.

rule.if: lease_deed_interpretation_case and fixed_initial_lease_term and renewal_starts_at_end_of_term and enhancement_is_tied_to_renewal and whole_deed_supports_end_of_term_trigger

predicates.lease_deed_interpretation_case: The proceeding concerns the interpretation of a deed granting a lease.
predicates.fixed_initial_lease_term: The deed states a fixed term for the initial lease.
predicates.renewal_starts_at_end_of_term: The deed provides that renewal is to take place at the end of the term already granted.
predicates.enhancement_is_tied_to_renewal: The deed connects rent enhancement to the grant of a renewal lease.
predicates.whole_deed_supports_end_of_term_trigger: The operative grant and the deed’s other terms support reading the renewal provisions as taking effect only when the initial term ends.

issues.definition: When a lease-deed interpretation case involves a fixed initial term, renewal at the end of that term, and enhancement tied to renewal, and the deed read as a whole supports that timing, enhancement is permitted only on a fresh lease.
